channel.title: API Video incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from API Video's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Analytics Issue Identified [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting the Analytics database has been resolved, and all Analytics services are now fully operational. Data retrieval through both the dashboard and API has been restored. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: Ongoing Database Incident [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting our database has been resolved, and all services are operating normally again. The incident was caused by an issue with our database provider, which has since been resolved. We appreciate your patience while we worked with our provider to restore full service. Thank you for your understanding. If you continue to experience any issues, please contact our support team.

item.title: Encoding Delay [resolved]
item.description: The encoding queue has been fully processed and the pipeline is now operating normally. All pending videos have been cleared, and processing times have returned to the standard latency. No further delays are expected at this time.

item.title: Network incident [resolved]
item.description: A service disruption occurred due to an unexpected underlying infrastructure malfunction. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.

item.title: Service availability limited [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Heavy traffic on our database servers caused access issues to our content delivery servers and affected the dashboard. We sincerely apologize for the outage and any inconvenience this may have caused.

item.title: Service Availability Issue [resolved]
item.description: A network-related issue caused DNS resolution failures for some of our internal services, which affected service availability for a significant portion of users during 55 minutes. Our team identified the root cause, resolved the network/DNS issue, and services are now fully restored. We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience.

item.title: Slowdown in video processing [resolved]
item.description: Queue has been treated, service is back to normal. An hypervisor failure was identified has the root cause of the slowdown

item.title: Major Incident - Dashboard, Live, VoD are impacted [resolved]
LiveStream service unstable [resolved]
item.description: The service has fully recovered. Performances have been optimal since 18:00 UTC.

item.title: AI jobs delayed [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved. Pending tasks are being processed. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

item.title: Incident on storage [resolved]
item.description: The storage has fully recover. The VOD ingest and delivery service are operational since 18:09 UTC.
